expect_red: a part joined to the parts above and below it by three constraints each, with a dimension straight through it from each upper end to a lower one, grows no taller than its cell has room for, and its name sits in the strip beside its pins

mutations.contract: A part's name may wrap into the strip between its box's start and its first top or bottom pin.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_base_stack_joints_are_seat_boss_and_pattern (2026-11-17). Without the strip wrap, the tangential link mount of model v2 -- three pins on top, three below, a dimension through it from each -- has no corner for its name and outgrows its cell.
